title: 第十八章 初级大赛第十九章 惊喜之作
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 冯斗并且马上继续斗战，他觉得自己在斗战之中，学到的东西远远超过修炼所得到一切。
很多时间不断地经历着生死之战，对于修炼来说重要性是非常之重大的，所以他一共参加十场比赛，以全胜结束了。
最后使得冯斗现在积分达到了五十积分，金币都已经超过三百万了。
他一下子暴富啦！他选择在拍卖场里买了不少的药材，因为为了炼药要用的，而且为这一次炼药大赛也准备了两份药材。
虽然大赛并没有次数限制，但是单纯从试药来说，只是够两次炼药时间，不可能再多了。
所以冯斗并没有准备太多的草药，因为准备多也是没有任何作用，还不如留点钱，为了以后的修炼。
过了三天之后，终于到了大赛，冯斗来到了大赛场，然而在场的人众多，大约都有一万多，这个远远低超出了他所意料之外，他本来以为这样的大赛顶多就几千来参加，怎么可能会有过万人的呢？
初级赛分为三轮，先说炼药，第二轮凝神，最后一轮就是聚丹，这些在一定程度上体现了一个炼药师的真正实力到底到达什么程度的，这些也是炼药师必经之道，所以这次大赛考这些，就充分证明了这次大赛注重基础的。
由于人数比较多，所以第一轮就在广场举行，因为在其他的地方根本就没有这个地方啊！
相当于来说，第一轮炼药在一点程度上是决定一个炼药师是否有成为一名炼药师的前提啊！
这时，全场的人都已经开始炼药，不断地有人将药材掉进药鼎之中，为了大赛的公平性，除了第三轮聚丹之外，必须使用大赛为他们准备的臣级一等鼎，这个足够让众人看到了药神界的底蕴多么雄厚。
单单是从大赛所使用的丹炉来说，就已经超过一亿金币，从这一点来说，就不是一般人能够比拟得起来的啦！
冯斗并没有太过于想那么多的，他随便找了一张桌子坐下来，同时选择炼制一棵简单的草药，因为第一关并不是追求任何东西，只有完成任务就可以了。
原本对于入选的人员有最为之基本的要求就是中级丹药师，还有就是灵修等级必须在仙机境，单单是这个要求，就已经将很多人已经局限死了，更加不用说其他要求了。
但是此次足够有一万多人参赛，这样就足够看得出药神界的重要性，因为此次大赛的前十名奖励是非常之惊人的，第一名就可以成为药神界的常任理事，第二名至第五名则是位于药神界的常任长老，至于第六名到到第十名则是药神界的常任太常，至于其他的奖品都是非常之惊人的。
冯斗这一次真正的目的就是想要争取第一名，只有成为常任理事之后，他才能够做到万无一失的。
此时众人都纷纷地开始炼药，他此时并不急的，他选择慢慢地开始，因为他并不是太过于希望自己太快地暴露自己的实力。
因为大赛分为三天，所以太过早地暴露自己，有可能为自己引来杀生之祸，这一点他比任何人都要清楚的，所以他选择了退让，退而求其次。
炼药对于他来说根本就不算什么了，他根本就不需要五个时辰才能够完成的，他只需要一刻时就已经足够，但他这样做必定会引起众人的吸引力，可是这样做，他必定会引来各大派的妒忌心。

content_en:
Feng Dou immediately continued to fight. He felt that what he learned during the fight was far more than anything he could gain from training.
He spent a lot of time constantly experiencing the battle of life and death, which was very important to his cultivation, so he participated in a total of ten games and ended with a complete victory.
In the end, Feng Dou now has fifty points and more than three million gold coins.
He suddenly became rich! He chose to buy a lot of medicinal materials at the auction house because they were needed for refining medicine, and he also prepared two quantities of medicinal materials for this medicine refining competition.
Although there is no limit to the number of times in the competition, purely from the perspective of testing medicine, it is only enough time to refine the medicine twice, and it cannot be more.
Therefore, Feng Dou did not prepare too many herbs, because preparing too much would have no effect. He might as well save some money for future practice.
After three days, the competition finally arrived. Feng Dou arrived at the competition venue. However, there were many people present, about ten thousand. This was far lower than he expected. He originally thought that only a few thousand people would participate in such a competition. How could there be more than ten thousand people?
The preliminary competition is divided into three rounds. The first is alchemy refining, the second round is concentrating, and the last round is pill gathering. These to a certain extent reflect the true strength of an alchemist. These are also the steps that an alchemist must go through, so testing these in this competition fully proves that this competition focuses on the basics.
Due to the large number of people, the first round was held in the square, because there was no such place anywhere else!
Equivalently speaking, the first round of refining medicine is to a certain extent the prerequisite for determining whether an alchemist can become an alchemist!
At this time, everyone in the audience had begun to refine medicine, and people kept dropping medicinal materials into the medicine cauldron. For the fairness of the competition, in addition to the third round of pill gathering, they must use the minister-level first-class cauldron prepared for them by the competition. This was enough for everyone to see how rich the medicine god world was.
The alchemy furnace used in the competition alone has exceeded 100 million gold coins. From this point of view, it is not something that ordinary people can compare with!
Feng Dou didn't think too much. He found a table and sat down at random, and chose to refine a simple herb, because the first level was not about pursuing anything, only completing the task.
Originally, the most basic requirements for the selected personnel were that they were intermediate alchemists, and that their spiritual cultivation level must be in the Immortal Machine Realm. This requirement alone has restricted many people to death, not to mention other requirements.
But this time there are more than 10,000 people participating, which is enough to show the importance of the Medicine God Realm, because the rewards for the top ten in this competition are very amazing. The first place can become the permanent director of the Medicine God Realm, the second to fifth place are the permanent elders of the Medicine God Realm, and the sixth to tenth place are the permanent Taichang of the Medicine God Realm. The other prizes are very amazing.
Feng Dou's real purpose this time is to strive for first place. Only after becoming a permanent director can he be foolproof.
At this time, everyone started refining the medicine one after another. He was not in a hurry at this time. He chose to start slowly because he did not want to reveal his strength too quickly.
Because the competition was divided into three days, exposing himself too early might lead to death. He knew this better than anyone else, so he chose to give in and settle for the next best thing.
Refining medicine is nothing to him. He doesn't need five hours to complete it. He only needs one moment. However, if he does this, he will definitely attract everyone's attention. But if he does this, he will definitely attract the jealousy of the major sects.
